name: string-art
title: String Art
description: Threads are strung around a ring of pins as a times table, then the multiplier morphs the figure from a cardioid through a nephroid and beyond.
useWhen: A math, algorithm or engineering story needs a precise generative figure that builds itself and then transforms.
An intro or section break should draw something intricate from simple rules, with a label that shows the rule.
A background needs fine linework that keeps a slow accent sweep running after the figure lands.
avoidWhen: The figure should be a natural spiral of dots rather than straight threads: use phyllotaxis.
The scene needs a looping background with no build-up: use flow-field.
The data is real and should be read as a chart.
author: Remocn

variables.label: From multiplier
variables.description: Multiplier at the start (2 draws a cardioid).

variables.label: To multiplier
variables.description: Multiplier at the end (3 is a nephroid, 4 a three-cusp epicycloid).

variables.label: String frames
variables.description: Frames for the threads to be strung, one pin after another.

variables.label: Morph frames
variables.description: Frames for the multiplier to drift from the start to the end. The component lasts 11.3 s, which fits the default.

variables.label: Accent sweep
variables.description: Length of the accent sweep, as a share of all threads; 0 turns it off.

variables.label: Label
variables.description: Show the running multiplier in the corner.
